newsitem.title: FRANCE: BNP, CCF cut base rate to 6.55 from 6.75.
newsitem.headline: BNP, CCF cut base rate to 6.55 from 6.75.

text.p: Banque Nationale de Paris (BNP) said on Friday it was cutting its bank base rate to 6.55 percent from 6.75 with effect from September 23.
A BNP spokeswoman said the rate reduction followed the movement in money market rates and the cut in the intervention rate by the Bank of France on Thursday.
Credit Commercial de France (CCF) also said it was cutting its lending rate by the same amount to 6.55 percent.
The BNP said the cut brought the base rate to its lowest level since 1973.
The Bank of France on Thursday trimmed its key intervention rate to 3.25 percent from 3.35.

The markets saw the Bank's rate reduction as a sign of confidence in the government's 1997 austerity budget unveiled the previous day and which was seen an important step toward France meeting the Maastricht criteria for joining in the launch of a single European currency in 1999.
